presets.description: The recommended start: shots about 1,700 px/s, gravity 1.6x, lively walls and rubber, low friction, flippers dead to slow hits so returns can be caught
Arcade with flippers that answer at once: full speed from the press, up in one frame (17 ms, arcade's take 36) and back in 25 ms; shots about 1,800 px/s, the strongest at the 2,600 cap
Floaty and easy to follow: shots about 1,550 px/s, gravity 1.25x, the liveliest walls and rubber, the least friction
A heavy ball that comes back fast: shots about 1,700 px/s and up to 2,100, gravity 2x, deader walls, punchy rubber
Today's numbers, a real machine's at this size: shots to 2,900 px/s, the slope's gravity, dead walls
